description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (6.6564) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (3.0309) less the matching prior-year period (3.2776).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 6.6564，加本财年累计 3.0309，减去上年同期累计 3.2776。

description.en: The model holds disclosed period-end common shares outstanding constant. Additional future dilution may change per-share value.
description.zh: 模型固定采用已披露的期末流通普通股数。未来进一步稀释可能改变每股价值。

description.en: Current cash and liquid investments are added. Borrowings and identified noncontrolling interests are deducted at carrying value.
description.zh: 加计期末现金与流动投资，按账面值扣除借款和已识别的非控股权益。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Revenue growth and EV / revenue are research assumptions reflecting expected economics and risk. The equity bridge uses disclosed carrying values. The multiple is sensitive to future margins and funding requirements.
method_note.zh: 营收增速和企业价值／营收倍数是反映业务预期与风险的研究假设。由企业价值换算至股权价值时采用披露账面值。倍数对未来利润率与资金需求敏感。

rationale.en: Launch sales normalize rapidly and recurring spending stays subdued.
rationale.zh: 首发销售很快恢复常态，持续性消费依然偏弱。

rationale.en: Major releases lift recognized revenue while recurrent spending stabilizes.
rationale.zh: 大作发行提升确认收入，持续性消费逐步企稳。

rationale.en: Stronger launch sell-through and repeat spending sustain the revenue step-up.
rationale.zh: 更强的新作销售与重复消费使收入台阶更持久。
